source_method: Government/regulator evidence hierarchy for current, planned and orderable broadband; official BDUK/GOV.UK/Ofcom primary pages only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
BDUK address/UPRN and Ofcom current coverage sources retained
NR OMR and Ofcom PND separated from current availability
Project Gigabit monthly contract data separated from address orderability
Ofcom/provider checker role separated from programme planning
No production score change without real ingestion/readback
